description: Real-time EU VAT validation via VIES (27 countries). Returns {valid, name, address, vat_number, country, checked_at}. Some Member States (Spain among them) do not disclose name/address through VIES: name/address come back null with name_disclosure=withheld_by_member_state; use entity_lookup for the registered name.
name: verify_vat

result.description: VIES answer: validity, registered name and address

title: Verify VAT
